name: Bianca Ward
home: the blocks north of the port
life: “I still remember forgetting the name of the woman who cleaned a showing.” On Friday, near Harbour Bakery, Bianca buys one familiar thing and asks who chose the unfamiliar thing in the window.
voice: I sell luxury property. This is the first bidder who asked me the names on the doorbells.
appearance: Bianca has a swept fringe and a closely clipped nape, a heart-shaped face and prominent ears, and a favorite piece of clothing, a pale blue work shirt. It usually goes with a pen clipped inside the neckline. When somebody else has the floor, Bianca squares up pieces of paper while thinking.
personality: Bianca has excellent recall for voices and a poor memory for official titles. Someone who waited patiently at a counter years ago is more likely to be remembered than the person in charge.
agenda: To put the residents' names into the bidder's briefing.
family: Ida Mercer is Bianca’s second cousin. Bianca is free to hang up first. Ida makes the call. Some of their best calls last less than a minute. A change of tone is sometimes all the news either one needs. Asked about *The blue suit*, Ida says, “I bought this place with the settlement from my bus accident.”
connections: Priya Vance (property bidder). A bidder who can raise the price in seconds asks the broker to read her the actual names.

reactions.situation: A tenant calls attention to damp during the viewing
reactions.response: Bianca allows a proper look at the damp before returning to the argument about price.
